The purpose of the role is to: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate appointments, service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way Offer general assistance to the Practice and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies We are looking for a positive and enthusiastic receptionist to join our established and hard working team. The role requires someone who is diligent, friendly and capable, someone who is self motivated, a good communicator and always striving for the best for the patients. Ideally the candidate will have experience of working in a reception environment within a healthcare setting but this is not essential as on-the-job training will be provided. Exceptional candidates without healthcare experience but with a strong and relevant background will also be considered. JOB TITLE: Receptionist REPORTS TO: Practice Manager HOURS: Morning sessions run from 07:45am until 12:45pm and afternoon sessions run from 13:45pm until 18:45pm. Job Summary: Offer general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice including the provision of clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the Practice team Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the Practice reception team are defined in the job description and may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Practice Manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels.

title: Administrator
description: We excited to offer a position for a part time administrator to join the team at Bersted Green Surgery. If you would like to work in a fast pace environment and have great attention to detail, come and join our friendly team. If you have any questions or would like to hear more about the role please contact Vicky on 01243 864843. The main duties of the role are transferring patient records in and out, coding, monitoring QOF alerts, inviting patients for annual reviews and vaccinations. To provide administrative support and services to all members of the practice team, ensuring these are carried out within practice guidelines and policies. Main Responsibilities: Transferring patient medical records in and out of the surgery. Invite patients for appointments for NHS health Checks, annual reviews and vaccinations. Coding of incoming documents. Design and run searches and reports as required. Monitor QOF alerts in co-ordination with the Administration Manager to ensure patient groups are targeted for appropriate action. General office duties as required. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested. Provide cover for members of the administration and reception team during periods of sickness and annual leave.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: The Trust is looking for a flexible and enthusiastic Receptionist/ Administrator to join our friendly and welcoming admin team at the Woodlands Centre for Acute Care. We are a 23-bed inpatient unit, comprising female and male wards, two 136 Place of Safety Suites, and the Crisis Resolution and Home Treatment (CRHT) team. This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop a broad range of administrative and interpersonal skills in a varied and rewarding environment. As a key member of the Reception and Administration team, the post-holder will support the smooth running of the overall Woodlands service, undertaking a range of reception and administrative duties. The position is fast-paced and people-focused, involving regular contact with patients, the multidisciplinary team (MDT), external agencies, and carers, both in person and over the phone. We are looking for someone with: Excellent customer service and communication skills Strong attention to detail and accuracy A flexible approach, with the ability to cover colleagues' annual leave and sickness when required A positive and professional attitude Welcome and assist members of the public, service users, carers/relatives, and staff in a professional and empathetic manner. Communicate clearly and sensitively, particularly when dealing with individuals who may be distressed or upset. Maintain the efficient operation of the reception area, ensuring all visitors and calls are managed promptly and appropriately. Provide general administrative support to the wider team as required, including filing, scanning, archiving, uploading documents, printing, auditing, and other administrative tasks to support the overall function of the team. Uphold the highest standards of confidentiality, data protection, and security at all times to safeguard both patient and staff information and their safety. Ensure accuracy and attention to detail in all administrative processes and record-keeping. Contribute to a positive and supportive working environment, demonstrating professionalism, flexibility, and teamwork in all interactions. Ensure the reception area and adjoining rooms are kept clean, tidy, and well-presented, reporting any maintenance issues as appropriate. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to handle sensitive situations with empathy and discretion. High level of attention to detail and accuracy. Ability to prioritise workload and manage time effectively in a busy environment. Commitment to delivering outstanding customer service and maintaining confidentiality. In order to be a successful Receptionist/Administrator in our team you will have: A relevant NVQ Level 2/3 qualification / RSA 3 or equivalent Experience in a Administration role or relevant administration experience Experience using Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word and Excel Experience of working within a physical or mental health care setting although not essential. Are familiar with the use of Carenotes It would also be advantageous if you: Have experience of working within NHS

title: Receptionist
description: Arlington Road Medical Practice is looking for a friendly, welcoming and organised Receptionist to join our team. As the first point of contact for our patients, you will play an important front-of-house role, providing a professional, compassionate and efficient service both at the reception desk and over the telephone. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, communicates confidently and calmly, and can work effectively as part of a busy GP practice team while ensuring patients receive the right support and information. You dont need any formal medical qualifications or previous experience in healthcare for this role great people skills are what really matter! Full training and development will be provided as part of your induction, giving you the knowledge and confidence you need to carry out the role effectively. Youll need to be a confident and clear communicator, as youll be speaking with patients both face-to-face and over the telephone. A good level of literacy is important, as the role involves reading and responding to information accurately. Typing and computer skills will also be a key part of the role , so youll need to be comfortable using IT and entering information accurately and efficiently. Most importantly, were looking for someone who is friendly, approachable, patient and compassionate , with a genuine desire to help people and provide an excellent service to our patients. Providing front-of-house reception , welcoming patients into the practice, checking them in and assisting with queries in a friendly and professional manner. Answering phone calls and dealing with patient queries. Booking, changing and cancelling appointments, including urgent and routine appointments. Checking and responding to messages, including clinical and administrative requests. Liaising with GPs, nurses, healthcare assistants and other members of the practice team. Signposting patients to the most appropriate service, such as a pharmacist, NHS 111, community services or a clinician. Handling sensitive and confidential information while maintaining patient confidentiality and data protection. Supporting the wider practice team with general administrative tasks. Dealing with patients in a professional, friendly and compassionate way As a Receptionist at Arlington Road Medical Practice, you will be an important part of our front-of-house team and one of the first points of contact for our patients. Youll provide a friendly, professional and helpful service both at the reception desk and over the telephone, helping patients access the right service or healthcare professional. Alongside patient-facing responsibilities, youll provide general administrative support to the practice team, helping with the smooth running of the practice and supporting our clinical and administrative colleagues. Good communication, a positive approach and the ability to work well as part of a team are key to the role. 1. Reception and Patient Services Welcome patients and visitors to the practice in a friendly, professional and helpful manner. Register and check in patients for appointments and clinics. Book, amend and cancel appointments both face-to-face and using the practices computerised appointment system. Contact patients to arrange appointments, reviews and clinics where appropriate. Register new patients, temporary residents and other patients in accordance with practice procedures, ensuring the appropriate information and forms are completed. Receive and deal with patient queries and messages both at the reception desk and electronically, passing information to the appropriate member of the practice team when required. Provide patients with appropriate information and signposting to help them access the most suitable service or healthcare professional. 2. Telephones and Communication Answer incoming telephone calls in a professional, friendly and helpful manner. Book, amend and cancel appointments over the telephone. Deal with general enquiries and provide appropriate information within the scope of the role. Communicate test results and other information to patients in accordance with practice procedures and confidentiality requirements. Take accurate messages and ensure they are passed to the appropriate member of the practice team. Transfer calls to the appropriate person or service when necessary. Communicate effectively with patients, carers, colleagues and other healthcare professionals, adapting communication where required to meet individual needs. 3. Hospital Post and Samples Receive hospital correspondence and post, date stamp and sort appropriately for scanning or further action. Receive samples from patients and staff, ensuring they are logged and processed correctly. Complete relevant forms and documentation where required. Check that samples are correctly labelled and packaged in accordance with practice procedures. Check fridges prior to collection where required. Ensure hospital correspondence and samples are prepared and ready for collection 4. Outgoing Mail Prepare, frank and log outgoing post in accordance with practice procedures. Ensure outgoing correspondence is handled securely and confidentially. 5. Confidential Waste and Shredding Dispose of confidential paperwork appropriately using the designated confidential waste facilities. Ensure patient and practice information is handled and disposed of in accordance with GDPR and practice confidentiality procedures. 6. Closing and Securing the Practice For staff working the late shift: Check that windows and external doors are securely locked. Ensure computers, equipment and lights are switched off where appropriate. Ensure the practice is secure and the burglar alarm is set when the building is empty. Report any security concerns or issues to the appropriate person. 7. General Responsibilities Carry out any other reasonable duties appropriate to the role and level of responsibility. Support colleagues and contribute to the smooth and effective running of the practice. Work as part of the wider practice team, maintaining a positive and professional approach at all times. Working hours and availability will be discussed as part of the application and interview process. Please note that morning-only availability is not suitable for this position . It is essential that candidates are able to work shifts that finish at 6:00pm and 6:30pm . The working pattern may include a combination of full-day and afternoon-only shifts.

title: Team Administrator
description: Would you like the opportunity to work in a specialist Veteran mental health team? We are looking for an experienced administrator to join our lively and passionate mental health team; supporting veterans and reservists presenting with mental health problems and their families. Some of our team have a personal connection to veteran's, either with a military background or holding a close relationship with someone who does. This role of administrator is to provide a comprehensive range of secretarial and administrative services to the team. To liaise with other departments and services and to respond effectively to enquiries from the general public, service users, referrers and other agencies. To consistently deliver a client focussed service, which promotes good customer service and effective working relationships. We cover Kent, Surrey and Sussex and deliver assessments, support and psychological therapy within our Op Courage team. This post will be based at Wentworth House at Crawley Hospital . The Team Administrator will provide a full secretarial and administrative service, having daily liaison with a wide range of staff at all levels and regular contact with people who use services and their carers, who may at times be distressed or angry. This includes providing dedicated administrative support for the service's Consultant Psychiatrist. The Team Administrator will be responsible for ensuring the effectiveness of the office environment for the team. About us Support the Trust's visions and values and in particular the promotion of a positive approach to diversity, equality, rights, and treating others with dignity and respect; to eliminate discrimination and disadvantage in service delivery and employment, and to manage, support or comply by adhering to the Trust's Equality and Diversity Policy. To protect the health and safety of our staff/workers, patients, and those attending our sites, we encourage our workforce to get fully vaccinated against COVID Job responsibilities Provide comprehensive secretarial support; handling all aspects of correspondence, processing referrals and dealing with enquiries Filing Produce letters and reports. Some letters and reports may contain very distressing content Send out routine correspondence and self help information Managing diaries Preparation of papers Facilitate meetings, preparing agendas, taking minutes Process mail Prepare presentation materials Person Specification Qualifications Essential NVQ 3 or equivalent RSA 3 or equivalent experience and evidence of further practical experience or equivalent Good standard of secondary education; GCSE at Grade C or above or equivalent Knowledge/Experience Proven experience of a range of secretarial procedures Experience of producing documents to a high standard of presentation with good accuracy Experience of maintaining office systems Experience of working as part of a team Disclosure and Barring Service Check This post is subject to the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act (Exceptions Order) 1975 and as such it will be necessary for a submission for Disclosure to be made to the Disclosure and Barring Service (formerly known as CRB) to check for any previous criminal convictions. Certificate of Sponsorship Applications from job seekers who require current Skilled worker sponsorship to work in the UK are welcome and will be considered alongside all other applications. For further information visit theUK Visas and Immigration website (Opens in a new tab). From 6 April 2017, skilled worker applicants, applying for entry clearance into the UK, have had to present a criminal record certificate from each country they have resided continuously or cumulatively for 12 months or more in the past 10 years. Adult dependants (over 18 years old) are also subject to this requirement.Guidance can be found here Criminal records checks for overseas applicants (Opens in a new tab). Employer name Sussex Partnership NHS Foundation Trust SERVICE ADDRESS: Wentworth House Crawley Hospital Crawley RH11 7DH Employer's website https://www.sussexpartnership.nhs.uk/ (Opens in a new tab)

title: Team Administrator / Coordinator
description: The Clinical Governance Team are looking for a committed and enthusiastic individual to provide high-quality secretarial and administrative support to our busy and friendly team. The successful candidate will be computer literate, with excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and a commitment to consistently delivering a high-quality service. In this role, you will act as a Team Administrator/Coordinator, requiring excellent communication skills and a proactive approach to supporting team activities. You will play a key role in ensuring governance processes run effectively, contributing to the delivery of safe, high-quality mental health care. This post requires a flexible and adaptable approach, with the ability to prioritise and manage a varied workload. You will work both independently and as part of a team. In return, we offer support, supervision, and development opportunities within a rewarding and impactful role. To provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to the Business Manager and wider team. To coordinate meetings, including preparing agendas, taking accurate minutes, and distributing documentation in a timely manner. To maintain and monitor staff sickness and absence records, ensuring accuracy and confidentiality of employee information. To use the Trust Shared Business System (Oracle) to raise requisitions, process orders, and receipt invoices as required. To maintain oversight of administrative processes and workflow within the team, supporting efficiency and effective service delivery. To consistently deliver a high-quality, service user-focused service, promoting excellent customer care and effective working relationships. To support clinical governance processes, including data management, reporting, and coordination of governance activity. Please see associated Job Description and Person Specification for more details on the main responsibilities. Please see the Job Description and Personal Specifications for full details of the role and responsibilities.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking for an enthusiastic receptionist to join our friendly and welcoming team, uniquely based in Uckfield Community Hospital. The working hours will be 5 hour shifts, 5 days a week, on a rota basis that is planned one month in advance. The shifts vary from a 7.45am to a 3pm start. You will be the first point of contact, both face-to-face and over the telephone and must have a professional, empathetic and personable manner. The role will involve a variety of administrative duties to support the clinical team and smooth running of the practice. Below details some of the main responsibilities and duties - - answer general queries and guide patients with practice procedures - arrange appointments - signpost patients to the most appropriate service - support patients with registering at our surgery - answering the telephone and greeting patients at the reception desk, always maintaining the highest level of professionalism

title: Receptionist / Administrator
description: Ardingly Court Surgery is based in Kemptown district of Brighton we are walking distance from Brighton train station and the St James Street bus stop. We are looking for someone who enjoys working in a busy environment and has a love of patient care. This is an opportunity for an enthusiastic, experienced, positive and flexible person(s) to be part of the Ardingly Court Surgery team. Benefits include NHS pension scheme (employer pays 14.38% currently this is topped up to 20% by government) & 5.6 weeks paid holiday entitlement. The role will be varied and fast paced. You will answer telephones calls and speak to patients face to face, book appointments, direct patients to the correct services, raise medication requests & ensure patients access the yearly reviews needed to manage their conditions. You will also have administration duties relating to the management of patient records in and out of the practice also health campaigns the practice is undertaking. Previous experience is desirable but not essential, full training will be given. To be a successful Medical Receptionist/ Administrator, its all about your skill set. You will have good communications skills, strong written and spoken English both face to face and over the telephone. You will also need sound IT skills. You must like dealing with people and you will be backed up by a supportive team and given full training to develop your skills, engagement and job satisfaction. As receptionist/ administrator you will: Have previous experience of working in a reception/ customer facing role. GP Surgery in particular would be desirable. Have a proven ability in a customer service environment Be able to demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills Enjoy working within a team Have strong organisation skills Have a good understanding of IT Be an effective multi-tasker Be willing to learn and committed to personal development The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the practice administration team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the reception admin leader or practice manager, dependent on current and evolving practice workload and staffing levels: Processing of clinical records in and out of practice (paper and electronic) efficiently recording all activities via internal processes (utilising spreadsheet and liaising with external notes storage company). Managing related EMIS (clinical records management system) workflow registration tasks, resolving any enquiries liaising with patient and or Primary Care Support England (PCSE) as required. Documenting all steps taken where necessary. Ordering labels via PCSE portal and recording status as per internal processes. Managing Subject Access Requests (providing information in line with data sharing processes) whilst being mindful of information Governance principles and time frames. Assisting with health campaigns contacting patients to book appointments for vaccinations, NHS Health checks and other practice priorities. Processing personal and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations, and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointments system Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail Taking messages and passing on information Filing and retrieving paperwork Processing repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team member and associated healthcare agencies and providers Clearing and re-stocking of consulting rooms as required Providing clerical assistance to practice staff as required from time to time, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning Provision of refreshments for staff and visitors as required; Keeping the kitchen area clean and tidy Keeping the reception area, notice-boards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Monitoring of stationery and other supplies Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice health & safety policy, the practice health & safety manual, and the practice infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way, free from hazards Actively reporting health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas generally clean, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holders role Undertaking periodic infection control training (minimum annually) Reporting potential risks identified Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of peoples rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies, and current legislation Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual, is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings priorities and rights. Personal/professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, with such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patients needs Effectively manage own time, workload and resources Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members Communicate effectively with patients and carers Recognise peoples needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work Participate in audit where appropriate

title: Receptionist - Hillrise Newhaven
description: Full Time Band 2 Administration Assistant Lewes and Havens Assessment and Treatment Service An exciting opportunity has arisen in the High Weald, Lewes and Havens Assessment and Treatment Service for 1 part time Band 2 Administration Assistant based at Hill Rise, Newhaven. We are looking for a well-organized, efficient administrator to be an effective member of the team. Preferably you will have experience in a medical setting or administration experience elsewhere. You will have good communication, organisational and time management skills. An ability to prioritise effectively in a busy environment is essential and well as having a flexible approach. The main duties of the role include filing clerk duties alongside undertaking reception responsibilities and general administration tasks. You must be proficient in the use of Microsoft Office including 'Outlook' and 'Word'. Experience in the use of databases is desirable as well as running and maintaining a complex filing system. Hours: Tues & Friday 8.30am to 5pm. For an informal discussion please contact Sammie Williams. sammie.williams@nhs.net Reception Duties Working shifts on the out-patient reception desk. Answering telephone calls, taking messages and passing on accurate information to the relevant members of staff. Deal with room bookings sent to the Outlook inbox and keep staff updated with their booking requests. Meet and greet service users, visitors and staff into the out-patient unit. Ensure that the person they are visiting is contacted regarding their arrival. Promote a positive image of the department by checking that notices and leaflets are up to date and well presented. Ensuring the reception area and clinic rooms are tidy and secure at the end of each working day. Opening the daily incoming post and passing to relevant person. Preparing prescription requests for reception supervisor. Administration Tasks Dealing with routine enquiries in a pleasant and helpful manner, communicating relevant information and referring to others as appropriate. Ensure that general office supplies are monitored especially with regards to the patient filing system. Ensure that all complaints, comments and suggestions are dealt with appropriately by timely reporting to supervisor.
